title: Make settled prompt revocation and observation retries return without new writes
outcome: An exact retry of a committed prompt-permission revocation, observation or confirmation returns the settled retained state without a new federation version or persistence write; new revocation still uses its current authority and version fences.
acceptance: A lost-reply retry of an already committed revocation can recover its revoked identity using the original request version without reviving or retargeting it.
Duplicate authenticated observation and confirmation leave federation version and durable state unchanged; conflicting or stale identities remain refused.
Behavioral controls cover local revocation and real authenticated observe/confirm duplicates before production routes mount.
